title: montia fontana subsp. minor
intro: Montia fontana subsp. minor, commonly known as Marsh Marigold, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Montiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Montia fontana subsp. minor include its ability to soothe skin irritations and wounds, as well as its potential to act as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
